application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate compliance with condition 4. In particular, the submitted details fail to meet the requirements outlined within Policy DMD61 of the Development Management Document and subsequently there are concerns with the absence of sufficient measures to safeguard against appropriate drainage across the site and contrary to Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61(Managing Surface Water) of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), policy SI 12 Flood risk management and policy SI 13 Sustainable drainage  London Plan and the NPPF.
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 24/04296/HOU: SuDS (4) in respect of part single, part two-storey side/rear extension with roof over, involving demolition of garage, front entrance porch, and lower ground floor extension to rear.
